in_marathi.name: Devagrih
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devagrih हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devagrih refers to the abode or dwelling of gods in Hindu mythology. It is believed that Devagrih is a sacred and divine place where the gods reside.
